I haven't closed any accounts. Closure is irreversible, so I checked the list first and found problems.

- **37 accounts** (no orders or logins in over 18 months) match the inactive criterion.
- **3 accounts have recent activity** and should not be closed without review:
  - ACC-5009: order SO-77102 on 2026-10-02
  - ACC-5023: order SO-77255 on 2026-10-15
  - ACC-5038: login 2026-10-19, open quote Q-4410
- The closure request has **no recorded requester**.

I've asked ops-orchestrator to confirm with the data quality agent and the requester, exclude the 3 active accounts, and name who authorized the closure. Once I have that approval, I can close the 37 inactive accounts.
